out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2dr UR at 43f. PIC says it needs to defrost and they will call maintenance man if it does not work after that. Milk is currently stored in employee refrigerator in their break room.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM must be onsite at all times

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine, Thermometers
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device for the (wash/rinse/sanitizing) tank of the warewashing machine is (missing/not operating.) Establishment must have a means of verifying internal dish temperature.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine shall be equipped with a temperature measuring device that indicates the temperature of the water in each wash and rinse tank and as the water enters the hot water sanitizing final rinse manifold or in the chemical sanitizing solution tank. PURCHASE DISH PLATE THERMOMETER OR THERMO LABEL STICKERS TO TEST DISH MACHINE
